notes: Fixes the actual File Explorer drag-and-drop workflow for full cover wraps. The original wrap drop handler explicitly used only files[0], so dropping five selected covers could only ever load the first one. The drop target now keeps the normal single-wrap splitter when exactly one image is dropped, but when two or more valid image files are dropped together it sends the complete dropped file list into the multi-cover splitter. This update targets the drag/drop handler itself rather than the file-picker button.
